alt: A kitchen photographed five times from the doorway, each frame showing the same room with different cabinet colors, hardware finishes, stone worktops, and flooring.
text:
the light reads completely different in each one
the same kitchen, five cabinet finishes.
the fourth is the one i keep coming back to. finish choices compound: one decision changes how everything else lands.
#kitchenfinishes #cabinetcolour #colourways #designobservation
